name: NGC 7678, host of SN 2021qvr (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7678, a spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2021qvr-hubble
story: A bright spiral with one heavy arm, listed as Arp 28 in the Atlas of Peculiar Galaxies. In 2021 an extremely rare Type II-L supernova, SN 2021qvr, exploded here, and Hubble followed up to pin down the star that gave rise to it.

claims.text: NGC 7678 is a bright spiral galaxy
Catalogued as Arp 28 among spiral galaxies with one heavy arm
AT2021qvr / ATLAS21zqo was discovered in NGC 7678 in 2021
SN 2021qvr is an extremely rare Type II-L supernova
The Hubble program studies the progenitor candidate in pre-explosion imaging
Program 16874 target position matches the supernova in NGC 7678
